content.short: Blinq is a derivatives layer for prediction markets offering leverage on event outcomes.
content.description: Blinq adds leverage to prediction market positions, letting a trader take amplified exposure to an outcome rather than posting the full notional. Leverage on a binary outcome behaves differently from leverage on a price, since the position resolves to zero or one rather than drifting toward a liquidation price.
content.meta: Take leveraged positions on prediction market outcomes instead of posting the full notional.
